results.corrected_title: Suno asks Boston federal court to dismiss publicity-rights class action by Jason Isbell and other musicians
results.corrected_summary: On 3 November 2026 Suno moved to dismiss a proposed class action by Jason Isbell, David Lowery, Guy Forsyth and Eduardo Calle in US District Court in Boston. The complaint relies on state right-of-publicity laws and Illinois' BIPA and contains no copyright claim. Suno argues that artist names work as genre shorthand, and that the First Amendment and copyright preemption apply. No ruling has been issued.
key_facts: Motion to dismiss filed 3 Nov 2026, before Judge Angel Kelley in Boston
Plaintiffs: Jason Isbell, David Lowery, Guy Forsyth, Eduardo Calle
Claims: right of publicity under laws of more than a dozen states, plus Illinois BIPA; no copyright claim
Opposition due 1 Dec 2026, Suno's reply due 15 Dec 2026; no ruling yet

results.corrected_title: OpenAI launches Images 2.6 in ChatGPT with animated GIFs and faster generation
results.corrected_summary: On 4 November 2026 OpenAI introduced Images 2.6 in ChatGPT, adding GIF creation from text or photos, with playback-speed and frame-level editing, and faster image generation. It is rolling out to all ChatGPT and Codex users on web, desktop and mobile. Developers get two new API models, GPT-Image-2.6 Flare (speed) and GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst (quality).
key_facts: GIFs can be generated from text or an uploaded photo
Users can change playback speed and edit individual frames
Image generation in ChatGPT is faster
API models: GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst
Rolling out to all ChatGPT and Codex users
